answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 36539 Country: India Title: I am living in a 1 BHK flat whose rent is 1,000/- and deposit amount I gave him is 1 lakh which I will get back in-shaAllah after 2/3 years Question: I am living in a 1 BHK flat whose rent is 1,000/- and deposit amount I gave him is 1 lakh which I will get back in-shaAllah after 2/3 years. The amount which I gave him, he used it to construct the same flat. Is the above deal halal? And one more that I wanted to know what is pagdi system which is mentioned as haram? Answer ID: 36539 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 428/428/M=1433) If due to pagdi system the standard rent was decreased then this dealing is not free from the doubt of interest. One should avoid such dealings. If due to deposit amount there was no concession in the rent of house but the rent was equal to rent that usually is charged in that area, then this dealing is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
